executive_report.overview: Northwind Coffee Roasters has a fast, server-rendered site with strong brew-guide content. Its main weaknesses are crawl hygiene (a soft 404 and a broken footer link), missing local and entity structured data, and limited AI-search readiness. All recommended fixes are template-level and can ship within four weeks.
executive_report.scope: 21 URLs discovered, 20 audited, 1 unverified (rate limited). 21 layers evaluated.
strengths: Server-rendered HTML with no blocking JS errors (Layer 7)
Clear information architecture: every product within two clicks (Layer 12)
AI crawlers explicitly allowed in robots.txt (Layer 5)
weaknesses: Brand entity under-specified for AI assistants (ISS-003)
limitations: No Google Search Console or GA4 access; projections are scenarios
Core Web Vitals from lab data only
executive_report.recommended_focus: Week 1: crawl hygiene and café schema. Week 2: entity data, llms.txt and LCP. Weeks 3-4: hreflang, social tags, analytics and validation.

issues.title: Soft 404 and broken footer link waste crawl budget
issues.cause: Legacy menu page left as an empty template; footer still links to a removed shop URL.
issues.impact: Search engines index a thin page and users hit a dead end from every page footer.

issues.title: Cafés have no LocalBusiness structured data
issues.cause: Café pages were built as plain content pages.
issues.impact: Weak eligibility for local packs and map-based answers in AI assistants.

issues.title: Brand entity is under-specified for AI search
issues.cause: Organization schema is minimal and no llms.txt summary exists.
issues.impact: AI assistants may describe the brand inaccurately or omit it from recommendations.

issues.title: Product page missing description and Product schema
issues.cause: Template field left empty when the product was added.
issues.impact: Lower CTR and no product rich results for this SKU.

issues.title: Slow mobile LCP on the home page
issues.cause: Uncompressed JPEG hero image and render-blocking fonts.
issues.impact: Poorer mobile experience; risk of failing Core Web Vitals.

issues.title: Spanish page lacks canonical and hreflang
issues.cause: Language variant added without international SEO tags.

issues.title: Open Graph tags missing on product and blog pages
issues.cause: OG tags only configured on three templates.
issues.impact: Shared links render without preview image, reducing social CTR.

issues.title: No ecommerce conversion tracking
issues.cause: GA4 installed with default page_view only.
issues.impact: Impossible to attribute revenue to organic or AI-referred traffic.

issues.title: Images without alt text
issues.cause: Blog editor does not require alt text.
issues.impact: Accessibility gap and missed image-search visibility.

evidence.observation: Returns HTTP 200 with an empty page template and no main content (soft 404).
Returns HTTP 404 but is linked from the site footer on every page.
No <meta name="description"> and no Product JSON-LD in initial HTML.
Organization schema present but without sameAs, address or foundingDate.
Mobile lab LCP 3.4 s; LCP element is a 1.2 MB JPEG hero image.
evidence.limitation: Lab data only; no CrUX field data available.

evidence.observation: No canonical and no hreflang annotations linking /es/ and /.
Server responded 429 Too Many Requests on three attempts.
evidence.limitation: Page content not verified; not classified as an SEO error.

evidence.observation: Address and opening hours shown as text only; no LocalBusiness markup.

fixes.title: Redirect legacy URLs and fix footer link
fixes.rationale: Search engines index a thin page and users hit a dead end from every page footer.

code_snippets.caution: Confirm the hosting platform supports server-level redirects.

fixes.rationale: Weak eligibility for local packs and map-based answers in AI assistants.
instructions: Add one JSON-LD block per café with address, geo and openingHours

code_snippets.caution: Use the exact address shown on the page.

fixes.title: Strengthen Organization entity and publish llms.txt

Publish /llms.txt with a short brand and product summary
